entries: Your Patron has bestowed you with an increased amount of their power. You gain an additional Pact Focus of your choice. You cannot select the same Pact Focus more than once.
You can learn this Elder Arcanum more than once, but you must select a different Pact Focus each time you learn it.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Blade
entries: You can focus your Patron's power into a sinister weapon. As a bonus action, you can conjure an Eldritch Blade in an empty hand. Each time you do, it takes the form of a non-magical melee weapon of your choice, with benefits:

items: It can be used as a Trinket for one Eldritch Invocation.
You can use your Pact modifier, in place of your Strength or Dexterity, for attack and damage rolls with this weapon.
You are proficient with this weapon if you weren't already.
Attacks with this weapon deal the same type of damage as your Eldritch Blast, but do not apply its other effects.

entries: The Eldritch Blade disappears if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you conjure another Eldritch Blade, if you dismiss your Eldritch Blade (no action required), or if you die.

You can bond a magic melee weapon as an Eldritch Blade by performing a 1-hour ritual. You can use a bonus action to shunt it to an extradimensional space or conjure it. Bonding a second weapon ends the bond for any previous weapons.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Domination
entries: You can extend your will through the chains of your eldritch bond. Once in between each short or long rest, you can cast {@spell dominate monster} without expending a spell slot.

If you target a creature that is under the effect of your hold monster spell with dominate monster, it automatically fails its saving throw against your dominate monster spell, but the effects of your hold monster spell instantly end.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Familiar
entries: You focus your Patron's power to bind an Eldritch Familiar. You learn {@spell conjure familiar|llspell} and can cast it as a ritual, but it does not count against your number of Spells Known. When you cast {@spell conjure familiar|llspell} it gains the following special benefits:

entries.name: Eldritch Forms
entries: Your Familiar can also take the form of one of the Eldritch Familiars: {@creature Aberrant Familiar|LLWrc|Aberrant}, {@creature Draconic Familiar|LLWrc|Draconic}, {@creature Faerie Familiar|LLWrc|Faerie}, {@creature Fiendish Familiar|LLWrc|Fiendish}.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The Familiar is bound to obey your orders to the best of its abilities. In combat, it shares your initiative and it acts on your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, however, it will only take the Dodge action on its turn unless you use your bonus action to command it to take an action from its stat block or another combat action.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: Whenever you cast a spell or use Eldritch Blast, you can choose for the spell, or any number of beams, to originate from the Familiar if you are within 60 feet of it.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Sight
entries: As an action, you can awaken your senses to the presence of magic within 30 feet, but you must concentrate on this effect. For the duration, you sense if any visible creature or object in range bears magic, learning its school of magic, if any.
This sense is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Spear
entries: Whenever you use Eldritch Blast or cast a Warlock spell that requires a ranged spell attack roll, the range is doubled.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Tome
entries: You focus your Patron's power into a dark grimoire known as an Eldritch Tome. It contains one copy of each Warlock spell you know and this Tome grants you the following benefits:

items: Your total number of Invocations Known increases by 1. This bonus Invocation must be chosen from those without prerequisites, and your Tome serves as its Trinket. At the end of each long rest, you can replace this Invocation with another Invocation, following the same restrictions.
At the end of a long rest you can replace one Warlock spell you know with another Warlock spell of the same level.
You can cast any Warlock spell contained within your Tome as a ritual if that Warlock spell has the ritual tag.

entries: You can spend 1 hour, which can be during a short or long rest, to conjure an exact copy of your Tome, destroying any previous Tomes. If you die your Tome turns to ash.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Wind
entries: As an action, you can infuse your Eldritch Blade with the full power of your Pact and disappear. Choose up to five creatures you can see within 60 feet and make a single Eldritch Blade attack against each one. On hit, they take 6d10 damage of the same type as your Eldritch Blast. Each attack also applies any additional effects of your Eldritch Blast. You then reappear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of one of your targets.
Once you use this Arcanum you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. However, if you have no uses left, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to use it again.

optionalfeature.name: Enspelled Blade
entries: You channel your eldritch magicks through your Pact Blade. Whenever you hit a creature with an Eldritch Blade attack, it applies all the additional effects of your Eldritch Blast from Invocations and your Patron, other than its damage, on hit.

optionalfeature.name: Erupting Blast
entries: When you damage a creature with Eldritch Blast you can use a bonus action to cause other targets of your choice within 5 feet of your target to take damage of the type of your Eldritch Blast equal to your Pact modifier (minimum of 1).

optionalfeature.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: As an action, you can enhance your vision with the ethereal energy of undeath, allowing you to see through solid objects within 30 feet. For 1 minute, you have darkvision if you did not already, and you perceive objects as ghostly, transparent shadows of themselves. You must concentrate on this sense as if you were concentrating on a spell.

optionalfeature.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
entries: The irises of your eyes are ringed with glowing elder runes. You can read and understand any written words, symbols, or scripts as if they were written in your native tongue.

optionalfeature.name: Favor of the Master
entries: You grant your Familiar a measure of your power. At the end of a long rest, choose one Warlock spell you know of 1st-level or higher. Your Familiar can cast it once, at a level equal to your Pact Magic spell slots without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Favored Servant
entries: Your Patron has granted you a great gift. Once between each long rest, can cast one of your Patron Spells at a level equal to your Pact Magic spell slots without expending a spell slot.
You can learn this Invocation multiple times, but it cannot be used to cast the same Patron Spell more than once.

optionalfeature.name: Gaze of Two Minds
entries: As an action, you can touch a willing Humanoid and perceive through its senses, but the effect requires your concentration. For the duration, you benefit from the target's special senses, but you are Blinded and Deafened to your own surroundings.

optionalfeature.name: Gift of the Deep Ones
entries: You manifest aquatic features. You can breathe underwater, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
At 5th level, you learn the {@spell water breathing} spell, and you can cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Grasp of Hadar
entries: When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast you can pull it up to 10 feet toward you in a line. The total distance you move a creature in one turn is halved for each size it is above Large.

optionalfeature.name: Greater Arcanum
entries: Choose a spell from the list below. You can cast the Greater Arcanum spell once at 7th-level, without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you must complete a long rest before you can cast your Greater Arcanum again.

optionalfeature.name: Greater Magicks
entries: Your Eldritch Tome has been saturated with magic, allowing you to draw upon an increased amount of eldritch potential. Your total number of Pact Magic spell slots increases by one.
You can unlock this Elder Arcanum more than once.

optionalfeature.name: Infernal Sight
entries: You can enhance your sight with the infernal magic of devils. You can see normally in dim light and darkness, both magical and nonmagical, out to a distance of 120 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Lance of Lethargy
entries: Whenever you damage a creature with Eldritch Blast you can halve its speed until the beginning of your next turn. You can only apply this effect to a creature once per turn.

optionalfeature.name: Mask of Many Faces
entries: Strange and sinister magics have made your form fluid. As an action, you can change your physical appearance and voice to match that of a creature that you have seen before, so long as the new appearance has the same arrangement of limbs. You determine the specifics, including your race, coloration, sex, height, weight, and hair length, but you cannot change sizes. Transforming does not affect your clothing or game statistics.

optionalfeature.name: Minion of Chaos
entries: As an action, you can infuse your Eldritch Familiar with the full power of your Pact, causing it to transform, significantly growing in power. This transformation uses the rules here:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: Your Familiar transforms into another creature of your choice of CR 6 or lower. This new creature must have the same creature type as your Familiar, and you need to have seen a living specimen of this new creature before.
Your Familiar uses the statistics of the creature, but retains its alignment, personality, and hit points. It gains temporary hit points equal twice to your Warlock level.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: If the creature can cast spells, you can order the Familiar to cast them, but it uses your spell slots to do so.

entries.name: Duration
entries: This transformation lasts for 1 minute, or until your Familiar is reduced to 0 hit points. You can cause your Familiar to transform this way once between each long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Minor Arcanum
entries: Choose a spell from the list below. You can cast the Minor Arcanum spell once at 6th-level, without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you must complete a long rest before you can cast your Minor Arcanum again.

optionalfeature.name: Misty Visions
entries: As an action, you shape otherworldly shadow into an illusory image of an object, creature, or a visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube in a spot you can see within 60 feet of. This image is purely visual; it cannot be accompanied by sound, smell, or other effects. It lasts for 10 minutes.
As an action, you can cause this illusory image to move to another spot within 60 feet. When you do so, you can choose for it to move in a way that appears natural for the image.
A creature that succeeds on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Spell save DC sees through the illusion.
Conjuring a second illusion dispels any previous illusions.

optionalfeature.name: Mystic Arcanum
entries: Choose a spell from the list below. You can cast the Mystic Arcanum spell once at 8th-level, without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you must complete a long rest before you can cast your Mystic Arcanum again.

optionalfeature.name: Occult Scholar
entries: The occult power of your Tome allows you to prepare spells and eldritch powers. Over the course of 1 hour, which can be during a short or long rest, you perform an occult ritual with your Tome to replace any number of your Spells Known with alternate Warlock spells equal to your Slot Level or lower.

Once between each long rest when you perform this ritual, you can forgo replacing your Spells Known to instead replace one Eldritch Invocation you know with another Invocation of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites

optionalfeature.name: Occult Warrior
entries: Your Eldritch Blade has been empowered by ancient, sinister magicks. Whenever you hit with an Eldritch Blade attack, you deal a bonus 1d8 damage of the same type as Eldritch Blast.
Also, after you hit a creature with an Eldritch Blade attack, it has disadvantage on the first saving throw that you force it to make before the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: One with Shadows
entries: You learn the invisibility spell, and can cast it once per long rest targeting only yourself without expending a spell slot so long as you are in an area of dim light or darkness.
At 9th level, it is no longer limited to once per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Otherworldly Nature
entries: Your very being is suffused with eldritch magic. You no longer need to eat, breathe, or sleep. Though, to gain the benefits of a long rest, you must spend 8 hours doing light activity. Also, for every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

optionalfeature.name: Otherworldly Step
entries: Your Blade cuts rifts through reality itself. When you make an attack with your Eldritch Blade, you can teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see before or after the attack.
In addition, when you take the Attack action and only make attacks with your Eldritch Blade, you can make an additional attack with your Eldritch Blade as part of that Attack action.

optionalfeature.name: Otherworldly Vigor
entries: You bolster yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life. As a bonus action, you can grant yourself temporary hit points equal to your Pact modifier (minimum of 1).

optionalfeature.name: Repelling Blast
entries: When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast you can push it up to 10 feet away from you in a line. The total distance you move a target in a turn is halved for each size above Large.

optionalfeature.name: Sylvan Speech
entries: You learn to speak Sylvan, and while speaking in Sylvan you can comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, they can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived in the past day.
At 7th level, you can speak in Sylvan to communicate with plants as if you were under the effects of {@spell speak with plants}.

optionalfeature.name: Thief of Five Fates
entries: As an action, you can force one creature you can see within 30 feet to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it must subtract 1d4 from any d20 roll it makes for 1 minute. You must concentrate on this feature to maintain the curse.
It can repeat its saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Creatures that succeed on this saving throw are immune to this effect until the next dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Thirsting Blade
entries: You can make two attacks with your Eldritch Blade, instead of one, whenever you take the Attack action. Moreover, if you use your action to cast a Warlock spell or use Eldritch Blast, you can make one Eldritch Blade attack as a bonus action.

optionalfeature.name: Tomb of Frost
entries: Whenever you take damage, you can use your reaction to instantaneously encase yourself in a crystal of ice. This ice has a number of hit points equal to ten times your Warlock level and an Armor Class of 10. The ice takes as much of the triggering damage as possible. While the ice crystal persists, you can't be targeted and are immune to all damage, but you are Incapacitated and Restrained.
At the start of your turn, you can choose for this effect to end, causing the ice crystal to melt as quickly as it appeared.
You can use this Invocation once between each short or long rest at no cost. When you have no uses remaining, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to use it again.

optionalfeature.name: Tome of Ancient Secrets
entries: Your Eldritch Tome gains two new pages, each detailing one 1st-level ritual spell of your choice from any class spell list. These spells count as Warlock spells for you, but they don't count against your total number of Spells Known.

You can add additional rituals to your Eldritch Tome, so long as the spell is equal to your Pact Magic spell slot level or lower. To do so, you perform a 1-hour ritual where you burn a scroll detailing the ritual spell, and 50 gold worth of material pleasing to your Patron per level of the spell. The ritual then appears in your Tome, and can only be cast as a ritual.

optionalfeature.name: Vitality of the Ageless
entries: Whenever you or your Eldritch Familiar regain hit points while you are within 30 feet of each other, you treat any dice rolled to determine hit points either you or your Familiar regain as their maximum possible value, in place of rolling.

optionalfeature.name: Voice of the Master
entries: You can communicate telepathically with your Familiar and can perceive through its senses as long as you are on the same plane of existence. If you are connected in this way, you can speak through your Familiar in your voice, even if the Familiar is incapable of speech.

optionalfeature.name: Whispers of the Grave
entries: You learn the {@spell speak with dead (alternate)|llspell} spell, and you can cast the spell at will, without expending a Pact Magic spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Witch Sight
entries: Your eyes glow with an unnatural pale green light. You have Truesight out to a radius of 10 feet while you are conscious.
At 15th level the radius of your Truesight becomes 30 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Chalice
entries: You can weave your Patron's power into an otherworldly chalice to be used in the creation of potions and poultices. As a bonus action, you can conjure an Eldritch Chalice in an empty hand. The Chalice is an ornate, Tiny cup which reflects the true nature of your Patron, and it grants you the following traits and benefits:

items: It can be used as a Trinket for one Eldritch Invocation.

It counts as both a set of Alchemist's Supplies and as an Herbalism Kit. When you make an ability check using the Chalice as either tool, you are considered proficient with them, and you can use your Pact modifier for the check.

At the end of each short or long rest, you can perform a Ritual with this Chalice to conjure one vial of liquid from the following options: acid, alchemist's fire, holy water, pure water, a potion of healing, or a potion of climbing. It retains potency until the end of your next long rest, or you perform the Ritual again, when it disappears.

entries: Your Eldritch Chalice disappears if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you conjure another Chalice, if you dismiss your Chalice (no action required), or if you die.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Flesh
entries: You channel your Patron's power to twist and transform your body. As a bonus action, you can transform into an unnatural fusion of yourself and your Patron's otherworldly nature. This transformation lasts until you use a bonus action to revert to your normal form, or you become Unconscious.

items: When not wearing armor or a shield, your Armor Class is equal to 10 + your Pact and Constitution modifiers.
Your body counts as a Spellcasting Focus for Warlock spells and Eldritch Blast. You must still expend material components that are consumed or have a gold cost.
At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to grant yourself temporary hit points equal to your Pact modifier (a minimum of 1).
You become unnatural and horrifying to look upon. You are considered proficient in Intimidation, and you can use your Pact ability for any Intimidation checks.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Hourglass
entries: You channel your Patron's power to create an otherworldly timekeeping device. As a bonus action, you can conjure an Eldritch Hourglass in an empty hand. This Hourglass takes the form of a Tiny timekeeping device of your choice, clearly constructed of otherworldly craftsmanship.

items: It can be used as a Trinket for one Eldritch Invocation.

When you fail a d20 roll, you can choose to re-roll, but you must use the new result. Once you use this feature to turn a failure into success, you must complete a short or long rest before you can use this feature again.
So long as you are not Surprised or Incapacitated, you can add your Pact modifier (minimum of +1) to initiative rolls.

entries: Your Eldritch Hourglass disappears if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you conjure another Hourglass, you dismiss your Hourglass (no action required), or if you die.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Instrument
entries: You focus your Patron's power into an Eldritch Instrument, a Musical Instrument of ethereal beauty. As a bonus action, you can conjure this Eldritch Instrument in an empty hand, and it takes the form of a Musical Instrument of your choice.

entries.name: Benefits
entries: While wielding the Instrument, it grants certain benefits:

items: Your number of Invocations Known increases by 1. This bonus Invocation must have Eldritch Instrument as its prerequisite, and your Eldritch Instrument is its Trinket.

You are considered proficient with this Instrument, and you can use your Pact Ability for ability checks with it. If you are already proficient with that Instrument, you can add double your Proficiency Bonus to checks with it.
When you use this Instrument as the Spellcasting Focus for a spell with a Verbal component or for Eldritch Blast, you can change any damage dealt to Thunder.

entries: Your Eldritch Instrument disappears if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you conjure another Instrument, if you dismiss the Instrument (no action required), or you die.

You can bond a magic Musical Instrument as your Eldritch Instrument with a 1-hour Ritual. You can use a bonus action to shunt, or conjure it from an extradimensional space. If you bond a second Instrument, any previous bonds are ended.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Shroud
entries: You weave your Patron's power into a mystical cloak to shield you from danger and hide your steps. As a bonus action, you can conjure an Eldritch Shroud on your shoulders, appearing as a spectral cloak reminiscent of your Patron's magic.

items: When you move into an area of shadow, darkness, or an area obscured by natural phenomenon such as fog or mist, you can become invisible while within that effect.
You are proficient in Stealth and can use your Pact Ability for Stealth checks. If already proficient in Stealth, you add double your Proficiency Bonus to your Stealth checks.

entries: The Eldritch Shroud disappears if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you conjure another Shroud, if you dismiss your Shroud (no action required), or if you die.

You can bond a magic robe or cloak as an Eldritch Shroud by performing a 1-hour Ritual. You can use a bonus action to shunt it to an extradimensional space or conjure it. Bonding a second robe or cloak ends the bond for any previous Shroud.

optionalfeature.name: Cloak of Winds
entries: When you fall while your Eldritch Shroud is equipped, you can subtract up to 100 feet from your fall before calculating your fall damage. Moreover, if you fall at least 5 feet, you can move horizontally 2 feet for every 1 foot you fall.

optionalfeature.name: Cup of Recovery
entries: Using your Eldritch Chalice as a Spellcasting Focus, you can cast the {@spell restoration|llspell} spell at Slot Level without expending a spell slot. Once you do, you cannot cast the spell in this way again until you finish a short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Echoes of Antiquity
entries: You gain proficiency in History, and you can use your Pact Ability for all History checks. If already proficient, you add double your Proficiency Bonus to all History checks.
If you make a History check related to an event in the place it occurred, you treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Focus
entries: You reinforce your mind with sinister otherworldly power. When you fail a saving throw to maintain your concentration on a Warlock spell, you can choose to succeed instead.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Pact modifier, and you regain all uses after a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Strike
entries: When you use Eldritch Blast, you can replace any number of beams with melee spell attacks. On hit, you deal the damage and apply the effects of one Eldritch Blast beam.
When you hit with an Eldritch Strike, you can use a bonus action on that turn to automatically Grapple your target.

optionalfeature.name: Harmonic Spellcasting
entries: When a creature within 30 feet casts a spell with a Verbal component, you can use a reaction to play alien harmonies on your Eldritch Instrument, forcing one target of that spell to make its initial saving throw with disadvantage.

optionalfeature.name: Piercing Note
entries: Whenever you deal Thunder damage with an Eldritch Blast from your Eldritch Instrument, you can forgo adding your Pact modifier to the damage to instead cause the target to become Deafened until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Unearthly Chorus
entries: When you produce an Eldritch Blast beam from your Eldritch Instrument, you can forgo making the normal spell attack roll to instead force one creature that can hear you within 60 feet to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it suffers the effects and damage of one beam of Eldritch Blast.

optionalfeature.name: Cauldron of Lost Knowledge
entries: Your Eldritch Chalice thirsts for knowledge. Over the course of 1 hour, you can perform an ancient Ritual where you pour one vial of liquid or a potion into your Eldritch Chalice. This liquid is destroyed, but it is then added to the liquids you can conjure with your Chalice at the end of a short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Smite
entries: Any time you hit a creature with a beam from your Eldritch Blast, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to deal bonus damage to the target equal to 1d8 + 1d8 per Slot Level.
Due to Foundry limitations, the Smite is implemented as a spell. Look at your spell tab.

optionalfeature.name: Iron Grip
entries: Your Eldritch Flesh grants you a climb speed equal to your walking speed, and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down, while leaving your hands free.

optionalfeature.name: Otherworldly Stasis
entries: As an action, you can shatter your Eldritch Hourglass over another willing creature of your choice, placing it into a state of stasis for 1 minute. At the end of this time, so long as it has not taken damage or been forced to make an ability check or saving throw, it gains all the benefits of a short rest.
After you do, you cannot conjure your Eldritch Hourglass until you expend a Pact Magic spell slot or finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Protective Cowl
entries: If you take damage while your Eldritch Shroud is equipped, you can use a reaction to halve the damage you would take. If you do, your Shroud disappears and must be conjured again.
You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your Pact modifier (a minimum of once). You regain one use when you finish a short rest, and all uses after a long rest.
If you have no uses left, you cannot conjure your Shroud.

optionalfeature.name: Incomprehensible Might
entries: While transformed by your Eldritch Flesh, you can use your Pact Ability, in place of Strength, for all Strength ability checks.
Also, your Eldritch Flesh transformation allows you to Grapple creatures up to two sizes larger than you.

optionalfeature.name: Stalker's Curse
entries: When you damage a creature with a Warlock spell or Eldritch Blast, you can use your bonus action on that turn to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of your target.

optionalfeature.name: Stolen Seconds
entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an Eldritch Blast from your Eldritch Hourglass, you can forgo the damage to force it to make a Charisma saving throw.
On a failure, the creature's speed becomes 0 until the beginning of its next turn, then you gain the benefits of the Dash action for the rest of your current turn.

optionalfeature.name: Time Dilation
entries: Once between each long rest, you can use your Eldritch Hourglass to cast either the {@spell haste} or {@spell slow} spell at your Slot Level, without expending a spell slot.

foundryActivities.name: Cast Haste OR Slow without a spell slot

optionalfeature.name: Umbral Shroud
entries: While your Eldritch Shroud is equipped and you are in an area of darkness or shadow, you are also considered invisible to any creatures that rely on Darkvision or any other feature, such as Devil's Sight, to see in darkness.

optionalfeature.name: Crawling Armor
entries: Your unnatural flesh can harden and twist to absorb blows. When you take damage while transformed by your Eldritch Flesh, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by your Pact modifier (minimum of 1).

optionalfeature.name: Enchanting Melody
entries: You learn the {@spell charm monster|xge} spell. Once per long rest, you can play your Eldritch Instrument and cast {@spell charm monster|xge} without expending a spell slot, and so long as you use your bonus action on each turn to continue playing your Eldritch Instrument, your concentration cannot be broken.

optionalfeature.name: Sanguine Obligation
entries: You can undergo a sinister 1-hour Ritual with another willing creature, at the end of which, they carve their name into your body. You can have a number of names carved into you equal to your Pact modifier. If you exceed that maximum, one name of your choice disappears from your flesh.
When a creature whose name you bear is reduced to 0 hit points, but not killed outright, its name disappears from your flesh and it falls to 1 hit point instead.

optionalfeature.name: Adamantine Hide
entries: When you transform using Eldritch Flesh, you can choose to reinforce your body with sinister magicks. For the duration of that transformation, you have Resistance to all Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and the damage types of your Eldritch Blast. However, your speed is reduced by 5 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Alchemical Rebirth
entries: Using your Eldritch Chalice as the Spellcasting Focus, you can cast the {@spell reincarnate} spell without expending a spell slot or its material components once between each long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Imperceivable Moments
entries: When you roll initiative, so long as you are not Incapacitated or Surprised, you can take one of the following actions before any other creature has the chance to act: Hide, Search, Use an Object, or move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

optionalfeature.name: Unholy Facsimile
entries: During the course of a long rest, you can perform a forgotten and unholy 1-hour Ritual which separates the Eldritch Flesh from your body, replicating the {@spell create simulacrum|llspell} spell.

This simulacrum is an Aberration; it has Vulnerability to Psychic damage instead of Fire, and neither you nor it can benefit from your Eldritch Flesh while it lives. As an action, you can touch the simulacrum to destroy and absorb it into yourself, regaining the benefits of your Eldritch Flesh.

optionalfeature.name: Temporal Rewind
entries: When you finish your turn, you can choose to undo the entire turn; any and all movement, actions, reactions, rolls, features, attacks, and spells are undone as if they never happened. All creatures then regain any hit points lost or resources spent.

You then return to the space in which you began your turn, and can take your turn again as normal. Creatures other than you are unaware that you have used this feature, and have no memory of the turn that was undone.
When you are not in combat, you can use this Arcanum to undo the previous 10 seconds, using the same guidelines.
You can use this feature once between each long rest with no negative effects. However, each subsequent time you use this feature before you rest, you gain one level of Exhaustion.

optionalfeature.name: Chronological Disjunction
entries: You know the {@spell time stop (alternate)|llspell} spell, and it counts as a Warlock spell for you. You can use your Eldritch Hourglass to cast time stop at 7th-level, without expending a spell slot once between each short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Flight
entries: While transformed into your Eldritch Flesh, you sprout great wings reminiscent of your Patron's nature, which grant you a flying speed equal to your walking speed. If you already have a flying speed, it increases by 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Conjure Self
entries: As an action, you can shatter your Eldritch Hourglass to open a temporal rift, pulling a potential future version of yourself into your time. This potential future self uses the rules below while it remains with you:

entries.name: Statistics
entries: Your Future Self has the same statistics as you, including ability scores and features from your class, race, or other sources. However, they share in your pool of spell slots and other limited-use features. When conjured, they have hit points equal to your Warlock level.

entries.name: Combat
entries: In Combat, your Future Self shares your initiative and acts during your turn. However, they act independently of you, and will aid you to the best of their abilities.

entries.name: Knowledge
entries: You can ask your Future Self a single question concerning the future. They will answer using the guidelines in the {@spell commune} spell. However, their knowledge is limited to things you may know in the future, determined by the DM.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Your Future Self returns to their time if you use a bonus action to conjure your Eldritch Hourglass, if they are reduced to 0 hit points, or after 1 hour has passed.
There can only ever be one version of your Future Self in your current time at once. Conjuring a second Future Self causes any others to instantly return to their time.

optionalfeature.name: Font of Unending Life
entries: At the end of a long rest, you can perform a Ritual of ancient power which grants you the following unnatural benefits until the end of your next long rest:

items: You stop aging, and return to the full vigor of your youth.
You have Immunity to Poison damage and you cannot be Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned by magic.
So long as you have at least 1 hit point, but less than half of your maximum hit points, you regain hit points equal to your Pact modifier at the start of each of your turns.

entries: However, if you finish a long rest and do not perform this Ritual, you immediately age as if you had never performed it.

foundryActivities.name: Perform Ritual of Unending Life (1-hour ritual)

optionalfeature.name: Primordial Transformation
entries: The power which infuses your flesh rivals the raw potential of creation. You learn the {@spell true polymorph} spell, and it becomes a Warlock spell for you. Once per long rest, you can cast it on yourself only, using the creature to creature option. When you do so, your concentration can't be broken by taking damage.

optionalfeature.name: Slip Away
entries: You can fade away from reality, only to reappear moments later. While your Eldritch Shroud is equipped, you can use a bonus action on each turn to teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet.
